title: Discogs Median Price Gap to Paid Cost
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=discogs:item
| search median_price=* paid_price=*
| stats avg(median_price-paid_price) as avg_gap sum(median_price-paid_price) as total_gap by collection_name
| sort 0 - avg_gap
description: Ranks collectionss by Discogs market gap versus paid cost.
value: The market gap tells you whether the collection is being built below, above, or roughly at the current median.
implementation: Send Discogs market gap versus paid cost events to `index=personal` and keep `collection_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of Discogs market gap versus paid cost by collections.
grandmaExplanation: It measures which collectionss stand out most for Discogs market gap versus paid cost.
